fusions.name: Long Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls a stiffened shaft of strands at a target up to 7 tiles away, dealing 40 piercing damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Three Casts
fusions.desc: Throws 3 shafts in a narrow cone 5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 8 piercing damage to everything in it. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Point Set
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Shaft
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, a shaft of strands lashes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 piercing damage. Once every 6 seconds.
